reviews.text: Thank you to the entire team, as well as Doctors Doyle and Gustin for Bao

I've never met such a wonderful veterinarian. Competent, empathetic, and gentle. She supported me through my cat's final days in the best possible way. I am eternally grateful.

So I came back today for my kitten's first checkup. Thank you.

Very attentive, welcoming, and always there for you in emergencies. A competent and professional team.

I highly recommend them.
Very good veterinarians.

Thank you so much! You treated and cured my cat, taking the time to explain why he was in that condition and showing me how to administer the medication. You reassured me greatly about his health, and in just two days he was much better! Very kind and professional.
Very professional and pleasant vets. Lovely veterinary assistants, always a warm welcome and good advice.
Excellent veterinarian. Very kind receptionist.
They are perfect
Absolutely perfect.
My cat is seen there. The vet was very friendly and gave me lots of advice about my cat's diet and health. I highly recommend them.
There are always good doctors for our animal friends; they are very professional. As a client for 35 years, I wish you an excellent day.

My dog ​​has been a patient of Dr. Gustin for 8 years; he is now 15 years old.

Dr. Gustin is compassionate, competent, and doesn't perform unnecessary tests—just what's needed.
The reception staff is pleasant.

I found this veterinary clinic while searching on Google for a place to take care of my tortoise. I made an appointment online. Parking was easy. I was greeted by a very kind and pleasant assistant. I was then seen by Dr. Dol, who was very kind and compassionate, as my tortoise was in poor condition (her eyes were closed, likely a sign of pneumonia). She provided immediate treatment, including antibiotics and advice on eye drops for the future. The consultation was reasonably priced at just over €60.
Unfortunately, my tortoise, who was very dehydrated, died that same evening.
The next day, when I called to inform the doctor, the lovely assistant on the phone had a kind word for me. I found that very thoughtful. This clinic was a wonderful find, with lovely and competent staff.
This is the first time I've seen a clinic send a card with a note after my cat went missing, thank you so much!
Very good, nothing to add
Great team, they took good care of our guinea pigs, thank you!

This clinic is a disaster, and I mean it!! They gave my cat a bad diagnosis, and the staff is arrogant, especially the skinny receptionist with her broken teeth who looks like a junkie. Honestly, I don't usually leave reviews, and it's not a personal issue, but for the sake of your pets, avoid this vet like the plague.
Very friendly and welcoming, always offering good advice without overcharging 👍 …
Excellent veterinary care and friendly staff
Dr gustin  excellent
A remarkable welcome
Wonderful people! Thank you again!

Three veterinarians, mostly for dogs and cats. Royal Canin/Specific store. Veterinary services are adequate, but in case of hospitalization, there is no human supervision overnight (electronic monitoring IV drip). My cat died alone, and they only realized it when they opened the door.

We were greeted this morning by three wonderful women.

At reception, we were met by a woman with impeccable interpersonal skills, welcoming and smiling.

Then two other equally remarkable and passionate professionals took care of our cat, Boulette, who had an ear problem. They provided clear and reassuring explanations, readily repeating things when necessary, always with kindness. What more could we ask for?
As an added bonus, the prices are very affordable and attractive. A wonderful experience, thank you to the whole team!
Caring and professional staff.
A veterinarian who listens and is competent. I recommend him.
A huge thank you to the vet who took such good care of my cat and didn't charge me for the ultrasound she performed. Very professional, I highly recommend her.
I received a very warm welcome and good advice.
These are the best vets in Marseille in my opinion. Truly humane and always available.
Excellent clinic! My dog ​​was seen in time. I thank the doctors for taking such good care of her and for being so kind to us, her owners, and for reassuring us.
I recommend Dr. Sophie Dol who was very competent with our dog.

Dr. Anne Granger
Thank you for your professionalism and warm welcome.
I highly recommend her.
Our cats dreaded this place, but they always came out well cared for. We highly recommend this establishment.

I came in with my cat this morning.

My cat is usually very uncooperative and even aggressive with the vet. To my great surprise, he didn't hiss once, and what's more, he didn't even feel the injection. Thank you to this blonde, blue-eyed vet who gave us such a warm welcome and cared for my cat with patience and empathy, all while reassuring him. I will definitely stay at this clinic with this vet! I am more than satisfied. My cat and I thank you again for your professionalism, your explanations, and your kindness.

Tristan and Liam
The doctor is very professional, kind, and reassuring. She helped us a lot, thank you very much.

It's been almost 5 years since my dog ​​started being treated at the Clinic! The team and doctors are kind, attentive, professional, and empathetic! Thank you for everything you do and the cheerful welcome you give us at every visit.

Excellent clinic with a very kind lady who truly loves animals. I was passing through Marseille when my dog ​​was injured, and the consultation fee was very reasonable. Thank you for seeing me so quickly!
Excellent veterinarian, welcoming and attentive to your needs. Pet food is available for purchase.

Superb professionalism from the veterinarians.
Human and Animal...

They saved my cat, Moumousse, from feline jaundice several years ago.
From hepatitis a month ago.
And they finally got rid of the ear polyps that were ruining her life, where other vets had failed because they kept coming back.
They treated my cat, Miaouss, who was suffering from sinus problems due to the aftereffects of abuse he suffered at the hands of his former owners.
And this week, they just saved my cat, Chouchou, from severe cystitis.
Since we discovered this clinic and their professionalism, we bring all the family animals there.
Dogs, cats...
They've been there for us through every loss, always with great empathy and compassion.

Even friends of mine who have their animals treated there speak highly of them.

I recommend them without hesitation! 👍
Everything's perfect. Okay

A fantastic veterinary clinic, attentive and doing everything possible to provide the necessary care, excellent support throughout the animal's follow-up, a very caring team – I highly recommend Agnes
Humanity and empathy for our furry friends. My cat is on the road to recovery.
Very competent and very welcoming.
Beyond providing excellent medical advice and care, the entire team has a wonderful rapport with the animals and also shows great empathy for their owners. Thank you to them.
I've known this clinic for a long time – they're top-notch, very professional, conscientious, and attentive to your needs. If you're looking for a good veterinarian, this is the clinic for you.
Professional, perfect welcome, clean.
Fantastic vet! I came in as an emergency and Tekila received a very thorough examination. Thank you!
The vet was so kind, very gentle and adorable
